svg.title: Ius Supporter Card Reconstructed
svg.desc: Rebuilt supporter-only form from the right-hand panel of the photographed yellow petition spread. $5 NON-VOTING wording is transcribed. Fine statement microcopy is omitted, and cell counts are approximate. Historic artwork for reference, not a current registration form.
